Hi all — technical notes to make staging smooth: 

- OneTrust staging: single PDF + manifest.csv in the zip root. Manifest columns we will populate: filename, control_id, control_title, doc_type, checksum_sha256, original_path.
- Whistic alternative: preferred for marketplace integrations; accepts zipped folder structure (preserves per-control PDFs). If you later want a Whistic listing, we can deliver a Whistic package as an additional artifact.
- Checksum: we’ll provide SHA256 (export_checksums.sha256); OneTrust will accept SHA256, but their UI shows MD5 as well — we should include both in the manifest if possible.
- PDF requirements: flattened, bookmarked at control-level (e.g., CC1 — CC6), OCR not required but helpful for portal search.
- Ingestion script: ingestion_script_v2.sh (small wrapper that uploads to our staging S3 and computes checksums and validates manifest). Running it locally will produce the test.zip automatically.

I’ll attach the script to the thread and run the test after Chloe uploads. If OneTrust ingestion fails for any metadata mapping, we’ll capture the OneTrust error JSON and loop with their support.

—Karthik
